hint.text: Inclusive means making something accessible for everyone to do, regardless of their age, gender or background.
hint.label: Inclusive

atoms.b: One of the biggest changes in ((ancient ++modern)) sport is how inclusive it’s become.
Today, most sports are no longer limited by things like ((++age sleep)), gender or disabilities.

feedback.finish: Thanks to modern technology, sports have been adapted for people with different disabilities to play and enjoy more easily.

instruction.text: You are talking to a girl from the early 1900s. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: Football is my favourite ((++sport spork))! I play it at school all the time. What do you like?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>Football is my favourite sport! I play it at school all the time. What do you like?</prosody>

atoms.b: You get to play sports? In my time, girls are not ((++allowed stopped)) to play many sports, especially at school.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '+1st'>You get to play sports? In my time, girls are not allowed to play many sports, especially at school.</prosody>

atoms.b: Yes, sport is for ((boys ++everyone))! In fact, we ((++have_to should_not)) do it every week in PE!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>Yes, sport is for everyone! In fact, we have to do it every week in PE!</prosody>

atoms.b: The government made it a law and they even give schools ((food ++money)) to buy new equipment and travel to competitions!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>The government made it a law and they even give schools money to buy new equipment and travel to competitions!</prosody>

feedback.finish: This law was introduced to keep children healthy and happy, and to create future generations of successful athletes.

feedback.finish: These are the names of the England women’s national football and rugby teams. They have both won lots of competitions in recent years.

atoms.b: In the ((++past future)), many sports were seen as something only men could do.
For a long time, women were not even allowed to ((++play drink)) sports or attend sporting events.
Thankfully, things have now ((stayed_the_same ++changed)). Britain has proudly produced many successful female teams and ((singers ++athletes)).
They have proven that sport is for ((nobody ++everyone)), and their success has inspired younger generations.
